name: hermes-skills-bidirectional-sync
description: Bidirectional sync between GitHub Hermes_Skills repo and local Hermes Agent environment — pulls upstream, syncs skills/memories/profiles to/from local, commits changes, runs audit
schedule_human: Weekly Sunday at 2:00 AM (runs before the 3 AM audit)
script_description: Python script that: (1) git pull upstream with stash/pop for local changes, (2) copies repo skills to ~/.hermes/skills/, (3) copies new/modified local skills back to repo, (4) syncs memories and profiles to repo, (5) commits and pushes changes (gracefully handles push failures), (6) runs audit
output_format: JSON report delivered via cronjob system
guardrails: no_agent=true -- script-only watchdog pattern, no LLM calls, no interactive prompts
enabled_toolsets restricted to terminal + file only -- no web, no delegation, no browser-use
Bidirectional sync: PULL first (github->local), then PUSH (local->github)
Threshold-based alerting: 10 checks, all must pass (no breaches = silent run)
Dry-run support: --dry-run flag skips ALL file operations (git_add_commit_push, cleanup, DEPENDENCY.md writes)
Windows python detection: uses shutil.which('python') not python3 (python3 is broken Store stub, exit 9009)
Path normalization: str(path) uses backslash separators on Windows -- substring filters fail silently; must normalize
File exclusions: sync_skills_push AND sync_skills_pull exclude profiles-export/, memories-export/, .hermes/, .git/, tools/, memories/
Delete safety: sync_skills_push delete phase excludes memories/ directory (CRITICAL FIX -- prevents accidental deletion of tracked memory files)
Duplicate detection: sync tracks duplicates in LOCAL_SKILLS_DIR and logs them; does NOT silently overwrite
Model pinned with fallback: primary=qwen/qwen3.6-35b (provider=qwen), fallback=poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free (provider=nous)
HERMES_HOME environment variable (C:\Users\Owner\AppData\Local\hermes) is used for all local paths
Git operations use commit author hermes-cronbot / cronbot@hermes.local
memories/ directory is TRACKED in repo (NOT gitignored) -- sync_memories copies to memories/ not memories-export/
profiles-export/ and memories-export/ directories are ALWAYS gitignored -- runtime data must never be committed
Git config core.autocrlf=true with .gitattributes text=auto normalizes line endings (CRLF working tree, LF storage)
OneDrive sync: if git fails with 'mmap failed', files may be cloud-only placeholders

validation_matrix.audit_passed: Post-sync audit reports 0 broken refs, 0 yaml errors, 0 duplicates
validation_matrix.no_orphaned_files: No files in profiles-export/ or memories-export/ after cleanup
validation_matrix.dependency_map_regenerated: DEPENDENCY.md has correct xref count matching current skills

self_healing_actions.git_pull_conflict: Abort sync, alert user, leave working tree unchanged
self_healing_actions.git_push_failure: Commit locally, record push_error in report, retry on next run
self_healing_actions.audit_failure_after_sync: Revert last sync batch, alert user with details
self_healing_actions.orphaned_export_dirs: Auto-clean profiles-export/ and memories-export/ after sync
